description: Enclosure CAD: a printed or machined case generated with build123d from the UHD features it must provide (openings, plungers, windows, light pipes, insert bosses, O-ring glands, threads, strap lugs, the lid joint) and the bodies the assembly places inside it; fit, wall, seal and alignment checks.

skills.summary: Describe an enclosure as a UHD module of features, configure the cad provider, generate, export and read the fit, wall, seal and alignment findings

tools.purpose: Python with build123d, numpy and scipy (enclosure generator; the fit analysis uses ext-harness-cad's voxel clearance field)
probe: exec "${PROTOBOARD_PYTHON:-python3}" -c 'import build123d, numpy, scipy; print("build123d " + build123d.__version__)'
tools.install: protoboard tools install cad (a project venv with these pins), or point PROTOBOARD_PYTHON at an interpreter with build123d==0.13.0 numpy==2.5.3 scipy==1.18.1

capabilities.summary: Enclosures (cases, caps, back covers) with build123d: generated from the features they provide and what goes inside them

generate.summary: Write the build123d design (job + script) and build it: parts, body, report with the fit analysis

export.summary: body.step, body.glb, body.manifest.json and, for print, an STL and a 3MF per printed part

extract.summary: Generated feature frames by interface id, and the artifacts the module should reference

check.summary: Drift against the model and the assembly, fit (collisions, clearance, containment), walls, seal squeeze, opening and plunger alignment, envelope

clearance_mm.description: gap between what goes inside and the walls (default 0.3)

clearance_top_mm.description: gap above the tallest part inside (default: clearance_mm)

min_wall_mm.description: thinnest wall allowed anywhere (default by process: print 0.8, machine 0.5)

material.description: material, e.g. PETG (recorded in the manifest; mass = volume × density)

cavity_mm.description: fixed cavity instead of one sized from the contents: { min, max } (box) or { centre, radius, z } (round)

split_z_mm.description: split plane height between base and lid (default: under the lid, at the joint)

joint.description: lid joint: { style: rabbet | flat, lip_height_mm, clearance_mm } (a joint O-ring makes it flat)

fasteners.description: screws (into heat-set inserts, from the joint interface) or none

exclude.description: instance paths placed in the assembly that are not inside the enclosure

resolution_mm.description: voxel size of the fit analysis (default 0.25)

operations.summary: Manufacturing Package: the print order of each printed enclosure (material, profile, each part's orientation and supports, inserts, O-rings, plungers, lid screws)
Manufacturing Package: the enclosure's checks (seal squeeze, buttons, plugs, lid joint, tight fits) from its build report
